note: Piper voice (public domain, LJ Speech). `say` is the spoken form; `text` is the caption shown in the .srt.

lines.text: Expired Domains. Every expired-domain list you browse, in one place.
lines.say: Expired Domains. Every expired domain list you browse, in one place.

lines.text: Browse ExpiredDomains.net as usual. The extension never opens pages or sends requests on its own.

lines.text: Open a list page and press Save page.

lines.text: Turn on auto-capture, and every list page you open is saved.

lines.text: The side panel updates live while you browse.
